data.content_ref: inline:The closure rule (SRC_004) — every attacker of a warrant's validity_node also attacks the carriage edge — contradicts the skeptical semantics if it changes the grounded extension: materializing attack edges can flip a previously accepted node to undecided, so the 'derived' labels are not the same as the original fixpoint's labels. Refuted if: for every warrant set, the grounded extension of the closed graph is identical to the grounded extension of the original graph.
